def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors=set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{bg}
    rects=[]
    for color in colors:
        ps=[[0]*(w+1) for _ in range(h+1)]
        pn=[[0]*(w+1) for _ in range(h+1)]
        for r in range(h):
            run=nr=0
            for c in range(w):
                run += grid[r][c]==color
                nr += grid[r][c]!=bg
                ps[r+1][c+1]=ps[r][c+1]+run
                pn[r+1][c+1]=pn[r][c+1]+nr
        def get(p,a,b,c,d): return p[b+1][d+1]-p[a][d+1]-p[b+1][c]+p[a][c]
        cand=[]
        for a in range(h):
            for b in range(a+1,h):
                for c in range(w):
                    for d in range(c+1,w):
                        area=(b-a+1)*(d-c+1)
                        n=get(ps,a,b,c,d)
                        if get(pn,a,b,c,d)==area and n>=max(4,ceil(.82*area)):
                            cand.append((area,n,a,b,c,d,color))
        cand.sort(reverse=True)
        chosen=[]
        for x in cand:
            area,n,a,b,c,d,col=x
            if any(a>=A and b<=B and c>=C and d<=D for _,_,A,B,C,D,_ in chosen): continue
            chosen.append(x)
        rects.extend(chosen)
    rects.sort(reverse=True)
    chosen=[]
    for x in rects:
        area,n,a,b,c,d,col=x
        if any(not (b<A or B<a or d<C or D<c) for _,_,A,B,C,D,_ in chosen): continue
        chosen.append(x)
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for area,n,a,b,c,d,col in chosen:
        for r in range(a,b+1):
            for c2 in range(c,d+1): out[r][c2]=col
    return out
